company.name: Talysis
company.shortDescription: Talysis Education is a data company focusing on iterative instructional design for educators and education providers.
company.description: Combining the analytical power with continuous research, Talysis Education unlocks educators and education providers to deliver quality through a robust, scalable, and effective solution that fortifies the education ecosystem. This continuous innovation loop allows Talysis Education to be a market leader in technological solutions for the education sector and offers customers an exponential growth in value over long-term commitments. Education providers gain a significant advantage in competing with other providers by being resilient to changes and continously changing student needs.
